## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation this feature would address.

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Alternatives considered

Have you thought of other ways to solve this? Why is your proposal better?

## Who would benefit?

- [ ] Business owners

- [ ] Freelancers / agencies

- [ ] Other: ___

## Priority

How important is this to you?

- [ ] Critical — the product is unusable without it
- [ ] High — I'd use MianScan more if this existed
- [ ] Medium — nice to have
- [ ] Low — just an idea

## Additional context

Any mockups, examples, or links that help explain the idea.
